narrativeProgression.description: Introduction and explanation of the goal.
Exporting a still frame from Premiere Pro.
Using a mask in Premiere Pro to isolate the unwanted object.
Inverting the mask to cut out the object.
Moving the main video clip to a higher track and placing the still frame below it.
Editing the still frame in Photoshop using content-aware fill.
Observing the edited still frame in Premiere Pro.
Fine-tuning the mask to remove a remaining edge.
Final demonstration of the clean plate with the unwanted object removed.
